sponges text index | photo index Phylum Porifera Yellow bumpy sponges
Awaiting identificationupdated Oct 2016

Where seen? There are various yellow or orange sponges which look like cones, lumpy fingers or bumps. They have yet to be identified. They are grouped together here for ease of display.


Tuas, Apr 05


Beting Bronok, Jun 03


Chek Jawa, Jan 02


Beting Bronok, Jun 10


Pulau Sekudu, Apr 06

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
